title: Unified OpenAI /v1/chat/completions & Streaming Inference Plane
user_problem_and_value: Provides standard OpenAI-compatible chat, tool calling, structured JSON schema, and SSE streaming across heterogeneous providers.
existing_tanpopo_rc9_capability: COMPLETE_FOR_RC9_SCOPE in internal/ingress/http/chat_completions.go (CR-09 auto include_usage, strict JSON schema capability check, blob_ref splicing).

potential_improvements_or_design: Preserve core pipeline while expanding reasoning_effort enum to [none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max] and adding annotations/citations fields.
enterprise_implications: Supports 80%+ of legacy enterprise LLM microservices with zero client code changes.
security_and_operational_considerations: Enforce MaxRequestBodyBytes, VirtualKey plane check (PROVIDER), and clean SSE abort without synthetic [DONE].

user_problem_and_value: Allows official Anthropic (@anthropic-ai/sdk / Claude Code) and Google GenAI (@google/genai) SDKs to connect via standard ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / GEMINI_BASE_URL without path-prefix rewrites.
existing_tanpopo_rc9_capability: MISSING at top level in RC9; callers must prepend /native/anthropic or /native/gemini (DEF-048 partial).
competitor_and_technology_evidence: Supported natively by Solo agentgateway (/v1/messages), Agent Router (/anthropic/v1/messages), Bifrost (/anthropic, /genai), and Ollama v0.40 (/v1/messages) (SRC-011, SRC-016, SRC-019, SRC-044).
potential_improvements_or_design: Mount top-level POST /v1/messages (+ /v1/messages/count_tokens) and /v1beta/models/{model}:{action} delegating into the native/bijective adapter pipeline with full VirtualKey, Policy, and FinOps enforcement.
enterprise_implications: Eliminates #1 developer onboarding friction for Claude Code and Gemini enterprise teams.
dependencies_and_constraints: Resolves DEF-048 split-role parity; preserves DEC-003 4-plane separation.
security_and_operational_considerations: Authenticate x-api-key, x-goog-api-key, and Authorization: Bearer vk_tp_* uniformly without leaking inbound headers upstream.

competitor_and_technology_evidence: OpenAI Responses API is the primary 2026 agentic surface (store:false encrypted_content, /compact, /input_tokens, 2h/8h background) (SRC-048); supported by Solo agentgateway and Portkey.
potential_improvements_or_design: Implement bijective /v1/responses across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, and Foundry; auto-translate /v1/chat/completions (tools + reasoning_effort) upward to /v1/responses on GPT-5.4+/6.2; wire responseCache.
enterprise_implications: Prevents silent agent breakages as enterprises migrate from GPT-4o to GPT-5.x/6.x.
dependencies_and_constraints: CAP-005, CAP-143; CT-08 fail-loudly validation on unsupported stateful parameters.
security_and_operational_considerations: Block or redirect OpenAI hosted remote mcp tool blocks through Tanpopo /mcp policy when DEC-003 governance is enforced.

title: Full-Method & Query-Aware /native/{dialect}/* Passthrough
user_problem_and_value: Unblocks lossless vendor-specific endpoints (Azure ?api-version=, GET /v1/models, Bedrock Converse, multipart uploads) on /native/{dialect}/{upstreamPath}.
existing_tanpopo_rc9_capability: PARTIAL_IMPLEMENTATION in internal/ingress/native/handler.go: hardcodes query params to alt/beta (:1798), mandates JSON model hint (:300), and prepends leading '/' in inspector.go:157 ('/model/...') while aws-bedrock/src/adapter.c:654 checks 'model/' without '/' (DEF-048).

potential_improvements_or_design: Allow manifest-declared query parameter allowlists (e.g., api-version), model-optional native routes (GET /v1/models), aligned '/'-prefixed inspector paths across host and adapters, and streaming multipart passthrough.
enterprise_implications: Guarantees 100% day-zero access to cutting-edge vendor betas under enterprise Vault and FinOps controls.
security_and_operational_considerations: Retain strict dot-segment / encoded-slash path traversal rejection and UNMETERED_FLAGGED fallback alerts.

title: Multi-Turn Cryptographic Reasoning Signature Continuity
user_problem_and_value: Prevents HTTP 400 errors and prompt-cache invalidation during multi-turn tool-calling reasoning loops across Gemini 2.5/3/4, Anthropic Claude 4/5, and OpenAI ZDR.
existing_tanpopo_rc9_capability: MISSING on unified /v1/chat/completions in RC9 (strict parser omits thought_signature / signature / redacted_thinking / encrypted_content).

enterprise_implications: Essential for production coding agents and multi-step enterprise tool workflows.
security_and_operational_considerations: Never forward an Anthropic/OpenAI cryptographic blob to a different vendor on failover; strip only if stateless re-reasoning policy is explicitly enabled.

security_and_operational_considerations: Scope idempotency keys strictly by (org_id, project_id, virtual_key_id) and seal cached response bodies with Project DEK.

security_and_operational_considerations: Cache short-lived STS/Entra tokens in BlindBroker RAM only (never persisted in plaintext); bind mTLS keys inside Vault.
